Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City SERVICE PIYAHENO DILG OPINION NO. 155 S. 2010 10 December 2010 ATIV. JOSE J. TORREFRANCA City Legal Officer II City Hall, Paraöaque City Dear Atty. Torrefranca: This has reference to your 06 December 2010 letter, requesting a clarificatory opinion on whether the City Mayor may immediately suspend an employee/respondent upon Order of the Office of the Ombudsman pending resolution of the respondent's Motion for Reconsideration. This is in connection with the Order dated 30 September 2010 of the Office of the Ombudsmanin OMB-C-A-10-0268-F (LSC), entitled : "Field Investigation Office vs. Marilou C. Tanael", suspending the respondent Marilou C. Tanael, Chief Accountant, that City. However, said respondent timely filed a Motion for Reconsideration of the said Ombudsman Order. Hence, the subject request. In reply thereto, we answer in the affirmative. Memorandum Circular No. 01, s. 2006, dated II April 2006 of the Office of the Ombudsman states that the filing of a Motion for Reconsideration or Petition for Review before the Office of the Ombudsman does not operate to stay the immediate implementation of the Ombudsman decisions, orders or resolutions, unless a temporary restraining order or writ of injunction is duly issued by the court of competent jurisdiction. Based on the aforesaid Memorandum Circular, Mayor Florencio M. Bernabe, Jr. should immediately implement the said Ombudsman Order preventively suspending respondent Tanael, as directed in the dispositive portion thereof, unless a temporary restraining order or writ of injunction is duly issued by the court of competent jurisdiction. We hope we have addressed your concern accordingly. Very truly yours, . JESUS .DO EIV Director Ill Legal:13/La 20 o' zoeae
